name: Adventurer's Lost Sack rests on the Shadowglen bench, not floating in the road (#8770)
contract: The realm-map pass left the Forgotten Sack (gameobject entry 90636, guid 6941386) floating 0.57 yd above the road. The pickup's own first-pass position sat on the Stonebench01 seat 7 yd away; the fix moves it back there. The narrow gap window proves it rests on the bench top rather than merely closer to the road's terrain (which would still read about +0.88).

steps.label: the sack stands at the bench
DISCRIMINATING: it rests on the bench top, not above it
